description: Tank Car Data 2017-2021 is a dataset listed in data.bts.gov (Bureau of Transportation Statistics open data), an open data portal of the Bureau of Transportation Statistics under the section "Railroads", published or maintained by USDOT/BTS. These are the count data for each type of Class III flammable liquid by each type of tank car, for each year. The data is based on information provided to the USDOT/Bureau of Transportation Statistics for the annual report: Fleet Compostion of Rail Tank Cars carrying Flammable Liquids. Preferred Citation: U.S. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Railroads". It has 4 columns, among them Year, Count, Tank Car Specification, Liquid Carried. The portal shows 2022-11-08 as the last data update. Attribution given: USDOT/BTS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-bts-data-bts-gov-portal.
